scope: Source audition of actual runtime-map bindings on retained canopy V3 geometry. The source scene deliberately omits installed rigid supports. No Unity/player inspection or geometry mutation occurred in this review.
comparisonBasis: Retained V3 source construction acceptance and native iteration03 material objections: smooth saturated red sheet, weak evidence of cloth wear, plain repair patches, dark noon/afternoon underside.
improvements: The new fine cotton source avoids the prior oversized towel-like weave. A subtle fabric grain is visible in the close hem and repair views.
Independent seam, valance and repair regions produce intentional material variation, and the exact patch boundaries align with the existing forms.
The repaired V3 front pocket/hem remains continuous in these views. No new focal hole or slit is established.

blockingMaterialFindings.finding: Broad cloudy mottling dominates nearly the whole membrane, competing with the actual sag and folds.
blockingMaterialFindings.evidence: The same soft light/dark islands remain in top-albedo, establishing that they are authored color variation rather than only lighting. Opposed lighting changes real fold shadows but leaves the broad cloudy impression.
blockingMaterialFindings.boundedFix: Reduce the broad fade/noise amplitude substantially and preserve larger quiet intact red areas. Concentrate stronger bleaching on exposed edges and selected worn fold/attachment areas; avoid replacing one uniform noise scale with another.

blockingMaterialFindings.finding: The hem has a near-continuous pale lower band and repeated dark vertical drips. Long seam abrasion reads as consistently pale fuzzy lines, including conspicuous stripes from below.
blockingMaterialFindings.evidence: Hem-albedo makes the continuous pale strip and repeated runoff pattern especially clear; under-sun/opposed show the seam bands dominating the shaded cloth.
blockingMaterialFindings.boundedFix: Break wear into irregular sections with variation in extent and intensity, leaving unworn gaps. Localize runoff beneath relevant attachment/seam or drainage sites and vary length/width. Keep the existing chart alignment and material regions.

blockingMaterialFindings.finding: The repair patches remain plain applied squares with a pale contour and little evidence of how they are attached.
blockingMaterialFindings.evidence: Repair sun/opposed/albedo views show the boundary clearly but no readable stitch construction. The light-facing contour also makes the patch lip feel thick.
blockingMaterialFindings.boundedFix: Use restrained texture/normal stitch rows and broken fibre abrasion along the existing exact patch contours, with a modest dye-lot difference. This review does not establish a geometry defect requiring new patch meshes. Avoid a continuous bright outline.

weaveScaleGuidance: Do not enlarge the physical weave merely to show individual threads over a6.5m canopy. Its subtle close-view presence is preferable to giant woven geometry. First remove the dominating macro cloud pattern, then judge the fine normal/roughness response in close opposed light and the actual native pixel coverage. A high normal strength or high-contrast baked yarn highlights should not compensate for lighting weakness.
geometryDirective: Retain canopy V3 geometry, UVs, supports and collider contract. Missing rigid supports in this isolated source render are intentional, not a final omission.
lightingLimit: These source lights cannot resolve the previously observed native noon underside deficit or validate the staged afternoon shade change. After the material revision, inspect matched native noon/16/17.5 shade and close lamp views separately, including successive frames.
nextGate: Re-render top/hem/repair under sun, opposed light and albedo after the bounded material revision. If broad cloud and uniform banding are removed while real cloth and repair construction remain readable, proceed to a native audition.
